content.text: {"route":"ready","reason":"The record covers the key witnesses (Proctor, Chief and Assistant Chief DUSM, Branch Chief, testing consultant, Career Board Presenter) and corroborating facts. The testing consultant confirmed full test time. The Proctor's pat-downs of White and Hispanic candidates and his practice of searching all candidates address comparators. Selectee qualifications and rankings are documented, and the Branch Chief's lack of knowledge of EEO activity is timed against the list creation. Complainant concedes his qualifications were not superior. Complainant was offered a hearing and chose a final decision, so the decision can be evaluated on this record. Minor weaknesses remain, such as limited detail on the protected bases and on non-selected vacancies, but they do not undermine adequacy."}
